title: Drifting Relay
prompt: A silent relay tumbles across your route.

options.label: Spend 1 Fuel to repair it
options.result: The relay broadcasts your call sign across the frontier.

options.label: Scan it from a distance
options.result: A cargo registry yields one useful shipment.

title: Solar Wake
prompt: A fresh solar wake could fling your fleet forward.

options.label: Ride the wake
options.result: The risky slingshot adds two movement to every unfinished ship.

options.label: Shelter behind the moonlet
options.result: You collect condensed fuel while waiting.

title: Frontier Festival
prompt: A remote station invites your crew to its launch festival.

options.label: Spend 1 Goods as a sponsor
options.result: The station celebrates your generosity.

options.label: Make a brief visit
options.result: Local growers restock your galley.

title: Micrometeor Rain
prompt: A glittering micrometeor front closes around the fleet.

options.label: Push through at full speed
options.result: You emerge ahead, but loose cargo is damaged.

options.label: Brace and protect the holds
options.result: The careful passage costs time but preserves the cargo.

title: Abandoned Foundry
prompt: An automated foundry still answers basic commands.

options.label: Spend 1 Carbon to restart it
options.result: The foundry prints a free booster module.

options.label: Salvage the outer frame
options.result: You recover a cache of ore.

title: Customs Buoy
prompt: A customs buoy requests a voluntary cargo declaration.

options.label: Return 1 random resource
options.result: Your exemplary paperwork earns public praise.

options.label: Take the long route
options.result: The detour is uneventful.

title: Carbon Comet
prompt: A porous comet carries unusually pure carbon.

options.label: Stop and mine it
options.result: The crew loads two Carbon.

options.label: Chart it for other travelers
options.result: The shared chart earns one Fame.

title: Distress Beacon
prompt: A damaged survey craft broadcasts a distress call.

options.label: Spend 1 Fuel to tow it home
options.result: The rescued crew tells everyone who helped them.

options.label: Leave emergency Food
options.result: The beacon logs your aid.

title: Gravity Knot
prompt: Space folds into a narrow gravity knot ahead.

options.label: Thread the center
options.result: A precise burn grants three extra movement.

options.label: Skirt the edge
options.result: The fleet stays on its planned course.

title: Pirate Decoy
prompt: A pirate decoy tries to draw your escort away.

options.label: Challenge the signal
options.result: Your cannon signature scares off the ambush.

options.label: Break contact
options.result: One ship must hold position for the rest of this flight.

title: Fungal Ark
prompt: A living ark offers spores in exchange for provisions.

options.label: Spend 1 Food
options.result: The ark exchanges the food for two Goods.

options.label: Observe without docking
options.result: The observation adds one Fame to your record.

title: Cold Reactor
prompt: A dormant reactor can power one last fabrication cycle.

options.label: Print a Freight Pod
options.result: The reactor completes a free freight module.

options.label: Print a Cannon
options.result: The reactor completes a free cannon module.

title: Dust Harvest
prompt: A mineral-rich dust lane crosses your route.

options.label: Filter the dense core
options.result: The filters collect two Ore.

options.label: Keep formation
options.result: Your fleet gains one extra movement.

title: Nomad Market
prompt: Nomad traders open a short-lived market beside your route.

options.label: Spend 1 Ore for supplies
options.result: The traders hand over one Food and one Fuel.

options.label: Exchange navigation news
options.result: The nomads add your name to their route map.

title: Engine Harmonics
prompt: A strange resonance rattles every engine mount.

options.label: Spend 1 Fuel to tune the drives
options.result: The synchronized drives add two movement.

options.label: Power down briefly
options.result: The vibration passes without damage.

title: Archive Capsule
prompt: A sealed archive capsule requests a new custodian.

options.label: Open the archive
options.result: The recovered maps earn two Fame, but fragile cargo is lost.

options.label: Deliver it unopened
options.result: The receiving network grants one Fame.

title: Ion Squall
prompt: An ion squall surges directly across the fleet.

options.label: Spend 1 Carbon on shielding
options.result: The improvised shielding preserves speed.

options.label: Weather the squall
options.result: A physical upgrade is shaken loose.

title: Fuel Bloom
prompt: A luminous cloud contains stable fuel droplets.

options.label: Collect the droplets
options.result: The holds receive two Fuel.

options.label: Broadcast the coordinates
options.result: Sharing the find earns one Fame.

title: Orbital Kitchen
prompt: A famous orbital kitchen needs an urgent delivery.

options.label: Spend 2 Food
options.result: The grateful chefs award three Fame.

options.label: Trade stories with the staff
options.result: You leave with one Food.

title: Magnetic Wreck
prompt: A wreck's magnetic field grips nearby metal.

options.label: Risk a close salvage
options.result: You recover a free cannon, but lose one random resource.

options.label: Mark the hazard
options.result: The safety notice earns one Fame.

title: Quiet Convoy
prompt: A quiet convoy asks to share your navigation corridor.

options.label: Escort the convoy
options.result: The convoy's gratitude becomes two Fame.

options.label: Send route coordinates
options.result: The convoy transfers one Goods.

title: Prototype Drive
prompt: A research team offers a volatile prototype drive.

options.label: Test the prototype
options.result: The drive adds three movement, then consumes one random resource.

options.label: Decline and review the notes
options.result: The notes improve one booster for free.

title: Comet Monastery
prompt: A monastery carved into a comet welcomes travelers.

options.label: Donate 1 Goods
options.result: The donation is remembered throughout the frontier.

options.label: Rest with the caretakers
options.result: They refill one Food.

title: Ore Moonlet
prompt: A tiny moonlet is rich in exposed ore seams.

options.label: Extract two Ore
options.result: The compact mining run fills two holds.

options.label: Publish a public survey
options.result: The survey earns one Fame.

title: Signal Garden
prompt: A garden of autonomous beacons begins copying your signal.

options.label: Compose a greeting
options.result: The greeting spreads, earning two Fame.

options.label: Harvest an unused cell
options.result: The cell provides one Fuel.

title: Freight Lottery
prompt: A cargo cooperative offers one sealed container.

options.label: Open the container
options.result: Inside is a free freight module.

options.label: Resell the claim
options.result: The claim brings one Goods.

title: Unstable Gate
prompt: An unstable gate flickers between two safe alignments.

options.label: Enter the gate
options.result: The jump adds four movement, but strips one physical upgrade.

options.label: Bypass the gate
options.result: You preserve the fleet and gather one Carbon.

title: Frontier Broadcast
prompt: A live frontier broadcast asks for a captain's story.

options.label: Join the broadcast
options.result: The interview adds one Fame.

options.label: Sponsor it with 1 Goods
options.result: The sponsored program adds three Fame.

title: Frozen Antenna
prompt: A frozen antenna contains valuable route logs.

options.label: Spend 1 Fuel to thaw it
options.result: The route logs add two movement and one Fame.

options.label: Leave a warning marker
options.result: The warning adds one Fame.

title: Hull Choir
prompt: Resonant crystals make every hull sing in harmony.

options.label: Record the resonance
options.result: The recording earns two Fame.

options.label: Collect crystal fragments
options.result: The fragments count as one Carbon and one Ore.

title: Emergency Dock
prompt: An emergency dock offers one rapid refit before it closes.

options.label: Install a Booster
options.result: The dock installs a free booster.

options.label: Install a Freight Pod
options.result: The dock installs a free freight pod.

title: Last Light
prompt: A fading beacon has enough power for one final message.

options.label: Carry its message onward
options.result: The promise earns two Fame but one ship stays to download it.

options.label: Recover its remaining cell
options.result: The cell provides one Fuel.
